text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey! I ordered the chashu ramen, didn't 
I?! No matter how you look at it, there 
ain't nearly enough chashu here!

At lunchtime—while waiting for the ramen I 
ordered, I ran into a difficult 
customer...

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text:
I-I am terribly sorry! I will bring it 
right over!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Before that, get on your knees and grovel! 
Grovel! That's basic manners, ain't it?!
choice_data_list: (You don't have to demand that much...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Come on, man, drop the prostration thing. 
The clerk already apologized, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I'm just tryin' to teach you a 
lesson in courtesy! That's basic 
hospitality manners for ya!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Making someone get on their knees and bow 
before everyone is far more disrespectful, 
don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
I'm the customer, so I decide that! 
Whatever I say goes, that's proper 
manners!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Then go ahead and explain proper etiquette 
to me! Come on!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haaah--!!

text_block_list.name: Customer A
text_block_list.text:
...Tch, what's with this jerk?! Totally 
killed the mood... Check, please! I'm out 
of here!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're an Academy Trainer, huh? What a 
disaster for our lunch breaks.

text_block_list.name: Clerk A
text_block_list.text:
Um, you've really saved me...! Thank you 
so much!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No! Please don't worry about it! I just 
did it on my own!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Everyone else, rest assured and enjoy your 
ramen!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry for causing such a commotion!
choice_data_list: Thanks to you, we can eat in peace!

You saved me... I froze up and couldn't 
move.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haha, that's great to hear!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'm starved too, let's eat! Boss, give me 
a large bowl of vegetable ramen!

Afterward, Katsuragi Ace showed off an 
appetite fitting for someone with such a 
bold and hearty spirit!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to force your way in and 
get hurt. When things get like that, just 
leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
No matter who the opponent is, I'm ready 
to stand tall and take them on!

Behind Katsuragi Ace's smiling face lay an 
unshakable confidence, radiating a 
dependable presence far beyond that of a 
mere student!
